claude_proposed_widenings.name: class_feature_on_hit_choice_rider
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Devious Strikes augments an existing Sneak Attack hit-resolution flow with optional rider choices, but class features only support passive, activation, or composite passive+activation mechanics today.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The following effects are now among your Cunning Strike options.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: sneak_attack_dice_cost
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Each rider spends a chosen number of Sneak Attack d6 from the current hit, which is not representable as use_count, charge_pool, or any existing activation cost.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: limit_turn_options
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Daze limits the target's next turn to exactly one of movement, an action, or a bonus action. Existing restrict_action_set only excludes named actions; it does not model a one-choice turn-economy lock.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: on its next turn, it can do only one of the following: move or take an action or a Bonus Action.
